facts.fact: The CNSS reports that on 21 April 2026 the national health insurance institute INAM officially launched its online services platform (SIAMU-INAM), including online registration of insured persons and electronic handling of care claims and reimbursements.
The CNSS reports that its online registration portal, open since 2018, lets employees and retirees, and since October 2025 non-salaried workers, affiliate and manage their rights online.
